title: UBS Global Wealth Report 2026: average versus median wealth
discussion_signal: The discussion emphasizes that average wealth can conceal the typical person’s experience and highlights the importance of median wealth and distribution when interpreting global economic gains.
linked_research_question: How can global wealth expand rapidly while median experience, regional position, and ownership remain sharply uneven?
limits: The post is secondary commentary on UBS research
Wealth measures depend on valuation and data coverage
It does not show causal pathways for mobility or ownership
